title: exec-staff-meeting-prep-notes-priya-2026-03-30
content:
Exec staff meeting prep — 2026-03-30

Attendees (planned): Priya (COO), Lila (CEO), Marco (CTO), Jen (Head Product), Omar (Head SRE), Diego (Head Sales), Alex (Head Eng Ops)

Meeting goals:
- Surface any cross-org risks for next-quarter launches (Dedicated GA, Private onboarding pilot)
- Quick health check on production SLOs and capacity plan for April/May
- Decide on temporary capacity commit for EMEA region to cover pilot customers
- Follow-ups and owner alignment (who needs to do what this week)

Top-line updates (2-3 bullets each):
1) Serving/runtime stability
- Recent regression: increased p95 for chat-gen on long-context models after kernel bump (seen 3/26-3/28). Mitigated by rollback to kernel v2.3.1; still investigating root cause.
- Current p95 (global) = 210ms (target 200ms). Tail (99) = 620ms — flagged.
- Ongoing: Diego and runtime team to triage with perf traces from 3/26; possible kv-cache interaction with new batching heuristic. (Owner: Marco; due: 2026-04-02)

2) Dedicated (reserved capacity) rollout
- Beta cohort (5 customers) onboarding on schedule; 2 customers in verification stage.
- Capacity utilization: average 72% across reserved pools; we need to plan burst capacity for enterprise trials next month.
- Asking exec decision: approve a short-term +20% GPU burst commit for April (cost ~ $120k incremental) to avoid throttles for trials.
- Impact: avoids sales friction and preserves SLA commitments.

3) Private deployments / pilot customers
- Pilot with FinReg client: network whitelist + HSM integration in final testing. Expected go-live mid-April pending security sign-off.
- Need legal to finalize addendum; Jen to confirm timeline with Legal. (Owner: Jen; due: 2026-04-06)

4) Redwood Optimize & cost tooling
- Early experiments with auto-batching recommendations reduced tokens/second cost by ~11% on sample workload.
- Next step: rollout A/B to 3 internal customers for 2 weeks. Need final opt-in messaging and console toggle. (Owner: Product; owner contact: Jen)

5) Observability / Console
- Token-level billing refresh planned for next week — small schema change to reporting pipeline (ENG-1427). Ops: coordinate migration window to avoid spike in downstream analytics.

Risks & open questions
- Can we commit the short-term EMEA burst without re-opening pricing approvals? Finance thinks yes for one month but needs spend owner.
- Kernel regression root cause: does it tie back to 1) batching changes, 2) kernel selection heuristics, or 3) hardware-specific scheduling? Need dedicated postmortem if not resolved within 1 week.
- Private pilot contract language: what liability limits acceptable for Compliance? Jen to work with Legal and Customer Success.

Proposed decisions for meeting
- Approve +20% burst for EMEA for April (yes/no) with cost owner: Sales/Rev Ops to take ownership of incremental spend.
- Greenlight A/B for Optimize recommendations for internal customers next week.
- Request kernel postmortem deadline: 2026-04-02.

Quick metrics snapshot (last 7 days) — rough/draft numbers
- API QPS (hosted) = 64k (up 8% w/w)
- Avg token cost (hosted) = $0.0019/token equivalent (weighted)
- Latency p95 = 210ms (target 200ms)
- Dedicated utilization = 72%
- Private pilot active leads = 3 ongoing

Action items (clear owners + due dates)
- Marco: run kernel perf comparisons and deliver initial RCA notes (due: 2026-04-02)
- Omar: confirm deployment migration window for billing schema change and notify analytics teams (due: 2026-03-31)
- Jen: follow up with Legal on Private pilot addendum language and confirm by 2026-04-06
- Diego / Sales Ops: confirm cost owner for EMEA burst and prepare a short justification memo for Finance (due: 2026-04-01)
- Product (Jen + Alex): finalize A/B test plan and console toggle wording (draft due: 2026-03-31)
- Priya: prepare 2-slide exec summary for meeting with recommended decisions and budget impact (due: 2026-03-30 EOD)
- All: Flag any other cross-team blockers in the shared doc before the meeting (link in linked_artifacts)

Notes-to-self / talking points (Priya)
- Emphasize that EMEA burst is temporary and aligned to revenue pilots — cost is recoverable if trials convert.
- Stress need for clear owner on billing schema migration — downstream analytics rely on stable schema.
- Ask Marco for mitigation steps if postmortem shows kernel change is incompatible with current batching approach — is a rollback path + patch timeline realistic?

Follow-up format (post-meeting)
- I will send minutes + consolidated action tracker within 24h. Suggesting we set a short follow-up on 2026-04-06 to check progress on legal/production items.

Scratch / draft points to clean later
- Could propose a short-term incentive for pilot customers to convert early (discount credits) — need revenue modeling.
- Check with infra on spot-instance availability in EMEA for April week 2 (cost-sensitive option).

Attachments / data to bring
- Perf traces (3/26-3/28) — runtime team (Marco)
- Beta customer list + capacity plan spreadsheet — Sales Ops (Diego)
- Private pilot contract draft — Legal / Jen

End of notes.
